description:
A settled answer is final. A caller outside a callee's recursive group can read the callee's return before the group's climb has finished, and keys activations on the intermediate rungs it sees.

Case (develop 28c59e780, json_roundtrip): roundtrip/1 reads Json.decode's ReturnType at revisions 1 and 2 (3 under fz-xxd.10's same-pass ask) and keys a same/2 activation per rung read: 16 same/2 activations (24 under fz-xxd.10); paper answer 8. fz-xxd.10's json ladder (Json.array/2, array_next/2 climbing to 6) is the same effect: the climb's depth depends on when readers first observe a rung. Minimal reproduction of an early "concluded" read: scratch afu15/probe/d.fz (3-member recursive group) - its early reads happen to see the final revision, so it costs nothing there; json is the case with teeth.

Mechanism (proven, scratch afu15/reader.md): World::answer_use (drive.rs ~902) gates a non-partner read on fact_is_concluded = no queued publisher (facts.rs ~275). Between steps of a recursive climb no member is queued, so concluded holds while the climb still has rungs to go; the next step is driven by a changed-revision wake, not a standing wait.

Refuted cures (probes S1-S5, scratch afu15/probe/settled.patch, all on develop, 665-fixture census):
- S1/S2 settled through unfinal reads: 654 fixtures fail "no ready producer". The chain from a callee's return runs back through the caller's own claims (1+2: ReturnType(fz_op_add_ii) <- Kernel.+'s ActivationInputs <- main/0's queued claim; main/0 is parked on it). Circular by construction.
- S3 the same, exempting the reader: correct predicate, but nothing re-asks a parked wait; quiescent_cone (scheduler.rs ~943) has the same blind spot. 654 fail.
- S4 settled along WAITS (the publisher's wait-closure has no queued work): predicate breaks the cycle, but the Settled wake (Scheduler::dependency_satisfies, FactSlot::is_settled) is reader-blind. 654 fail.
- S5 S4 plus a matching wake (re-check parked jobs after each completion): correct everywhere (593 ok = base, outputs identical, empty-agenda fallback never reached) but does not cure json: AnalyzeActivation 684 -> 746, same/2 16 -> 24, decode ReturnType 2 -> 3 revisions; census +246 jobs, 67 fixtures rise; 51,216 re-checks on json. A climb advances by revision wakes, so "no queued work in the group" holds between its steps too.

Open question (paper first before any design): what fact says a recursive group's climb is finished, without reading through the caller's claims? Candidates to weigh: the group's own fixpoint (every member re-ran with no change) as a first-class fact; widening by a budget that does not depend on observation order.

Close when: on json_roundtrip roundtrip/1 reads decode's ReturnType once at its final revision and same/2 activations equal the paper answer (8); fz-xxd.10's json ladder pin returns to no climbing rows; no fixture rises; outputs identical.

History: the original +1 on six worked programs was visible only under fz-afu.13's FZ_PROBE_PULL, which no longer exists; on develop 1+2 runs DeriveExecutableFacts(main/0) once (144 jobs). The settled-use wake census (afu4/settled, 788 useless wakes) remains the measure for the DeriveExecutableFacts half.
title: A caller reads a recursive callee's return only once its climb has finished
